facts.fact: 没人打电话给她——除了催「没贷过的学生贷」的骗子；来电是 Dr. Voss 令她胃部打结。
facts.anchor: Who in their right mind would be calling me? No one calls me.

facts.fact: 四个月前第三次自杀未遂（吞药），Helena 有法律依据收治却改协议：每周谈话换自由。
facts.anchor: After my third failed suicide attempt four months ago—pills this time

facts.fact: 每周五通话=拴狗绳：长到能换城市、短到无法消失；明日还有一场（会议改期）。
facts.anchor: Now I’m tethered to Helena by a phone call each Friday afternoon.

facts.fact: 72 小时强制留观她经历过——知道里面的噪音、强制社交与居高临下的员工是另一种地狱，所以接受协议。
facts.anchor: I agreed because the alternative was worse. Having spent time in a seventy-two hour hold once before

facts.fact: 医生问睡眠，她想起梦与花却撒谎「Fine. No issues」；情绪答「Stellar/拉拉队」。
facts.anchor: I falter in my steps as every thought snaps to the dreams and the flowers that appear after them.

facts.fact: 自曝仍是波士顿那个 depressed piece of shit，只换了景色与气温；Emily=四号寄养妈妈因胸部嫉妒赶她走。
facts.anchor: I’m still the same depressed piece of shit I was in Boston

facts.fact: 发现屋顶门（钥匙能开、房东未提）——她把宇宙当自杀出口的同谋。
facts.anchor: Maybe it’s the universe nudging me along, providing a convenient exit strategy.

facts.fact: 章末：脊背刺痒、寒毛立起后一股暖意包住她，有东西替她拨开头发——「被观察」升级「被触碰」。
facts.anchor: But then a sense of calming warmth envelopes me
